auth.title: Authentication
highlights:
# Authentication

> Authenticate server-side API requests with your Higgsfield key and secret.

Create and manage API credentials in Higgsfield Console. Each credential consists of a key ID and a secret.

## Authorization header

Send both values in the `Authorization` header:

```http
Authorization: Key YOUR_KEY_ID:YOUR_KEY_SECRET

```

```bash
curl https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/REQUEST_ID/status \
  --header "Authorization: Key ${HF_API_KEY_ID}:${HF_API_KEY_SECRET}"

```

The API also accepts the legacy `hf-api-key` and `hf-secret` headers. New integrations should use the `Authorization` header.

## Keep credentials server-side

> [!WARNING]
> 
> Do not call the API directly from browser or mobile application code. Anyone who can inspect the application can extract its API secret and use your account.

- Store credentials in a secrets manager or encrypted environment variables.
- Use separate credentials for development and production.
- Never include credentials in URLs, logs, screenshots, or support messages.
- Rotate a credential immediately if it may have been exposed.

## Authentication errors

Missing, malformed, or invalid credentials return `401 Unauthorized`:

```json
{
  "detail": "Invalid credentials"
}

```

Authentication identifies the account, but individual models may have separate access restrictions. A model unavailable to the authenticated account can return `404`, `423`, or `503` depending on its operational state.

auth.title: Quickstart
highlights:
# Quickstart

> Submit a generation request and retrieve its result.

This guide uses the REST API so you can see the complete request lifecycle. It takes about five minutes.

## Prerequisites

- A Higgsfield Console account
- An API key ID and secret
- `curl` and `jq`

> [!WARNING]
> 
> API credentials grant access to your account and its balance. Use them only in server-side code and never commit them to source control.

## 1. Configure credentials

```bash
export HF_API_KEY_ID="your-api-key-id"
export HF_API_KEY_SECRET="your-api-key-secret"
export IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')

```

## 2. Submit a generation

```bash
RESPONSE=$(curl --silent --show-error --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url https://api.higgsfield.ai/higgsfield-ai/soul/v2/standard \
  --header "Authorization: Key ${HF_API_KEY_ID}:${HF_API_KEY_SECRET}" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --header "Idempotency-Key: ${IDEMPOTENCY_KEY}" \
  --data '{
    "prompt": "A quiet alpine lake at sunrise, editorial photography"
  }')

echo "$RESPONSE" | jq
export REQUEST_ID=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq --raw-output '.request_id')

```

The initial response has the `queued` status:

```json
{
  "status": "queued",
  "request_id": "d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff",
  "status_url": "https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/status",
  "cancel_url": "https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/cancel"
}

```

If submission times out before you receive this response, repeat it with the same `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`. See Idempotent requests.

## 3. Check the result

```bash
curl --silent --show-error --fail-with-body \
  --url "https://api.higgsfield.ai/requests/${REQUEST_ID}/status" \
  --header "Authorization: Key ${HF_API_KEY_ID}:${HF_API_KEY_SECRET}" | jq

```

auth.title: Headers
highlights:
# Headers

> Every request header, query parameter and response header the API uses.

## Request headers

| Header | Required | Applies to | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Authorization` | Yes | All endpoints | `Key <key-id>:<key-secret>`. See Authentication. |
| `Content-Type` | For a body | Requests with a JSON body | `application/json`. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | No | Generation requests | 1–255 visible ASCII characters, a UUID is recommended. Retrying with the same key returns the original request instead of creating a new one. See Idempotent requests. |
| `Hf-Expires-After` | No | Generation requests | Seconds to keep the request's data after it finishes, from 3600 to your account retention. It can only shorten retention; out-of-range values return `422`. See Data retention and deletion. |

`hf-api-key` and `hf-secret` are accepted as a legacy alternative to `Authorization`. New integrations should use `Authorization`.

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Applies to | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hf_webhook` | Generation requests | URL-encoded HTTPS endpoint that receives the result when the request finishes. See Webhooks. |

## Response headers

| Header | Returned | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Correlation-ID` | Every response | Identifier Higgsfield assigns to this API call. Record it with the `request_id` and include both when contacting support. |
| `Retry-After` | `429` responses | Seconds to wait before retrying. See Rate limits. |
| `Cache-Control: no-store` | `403` responses for a disabled or expired API key | Do not cache the error. |

auth.title: Client libraries
highlights:
# Client libraries

> Use the official Python and TypeScript SDKs.

Official SDKs handle authentication, submission, polling, cancellation, and file uploads. Use them only in trusted server-side environments.

> [card] Python
> 
> Synchronous and asynchronous APIs for Python 3.8+.

> [card] Node.js and TypeScript
> 
> Typed server-side client with automatic polling and retries.

## Python

### Install

```bash
pip install higgsfield-client

```

### Configure credentials

```bash
export HF_KEY="your-api-key-id:your-api-key-secret"

```

...

## Node.js and TypeScript

### Install

```bash
npm install @higgsfield/client

```

### Configure credentials

```bash
export HF_CREDENTIALS="your-api-key-id:your-api-key-secret"

```

### Submit and wait

```typescript
import { config, higgsfield } from "@higgsfield/client/v2";

config({
  credentials: process.env.HF_CREDENTIALS,
});

const result = await higgsfield.subscribe(
  "higgsfield-ai/soul/v2/standard",
  {
    input: {
      prompt: "Editorial portrait in soft daylight",
    },
    withPolling: true,
  },
);

if (result.status === "completed") {
  console.log(result.images?.[0]?.url);
}

```

The v2 TypeScript client is server-side only and blocks browser use to prevent credential exposure.

gate.title: What Is the Higgsfield API and How Do I Get Started
highlights:
The Higgsfield API lets you generate video and images from your own code: one API key opens every model in the API catalog, and each request is paid in US dollars from a prepaid balance. No plan or subscription is involved: fund the balance, send requests at the rates listed in the catalog, and new requests simply wait once the balance hits zero.

## How is the API different from my Higgsfield plan?

A subscription on higgsfield.ai and the API are two separate products with separate billing. Your plan, credits, and Unlimited access exist only on the website; the API runs on its own account balance in US dollars.

How is the API different from my Higgsfield plan?

| Criteria | Higgsfield plan (higgsfield.ai) | Higgsfield API |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Who it's for | Creators working in the visual interface | Developers building generation into their own products |
| Billing | Subscription plus credits | US dollar balance, pay per generation |
| Unlimited models | Yes, where included in plan | Not applicable |
| Requires the other | No | No |

## Which models are available through the API?

One API key unlocks every model in the API catalog: 50+ current video and image models, including Seedance, Kling, Wan, MiniMax, PixVerse, LTX, and Grok for video and Ideogram, Recraft, and Qwen for images, alongside Higgsfield's own Soul 2, Soul Cinema, DoP, and Marketing Studio Image. The API has its own curated catalog, and the selection may differ from the model lineup on higgsfield.ai.

Every model has its own catalog page listing the current rate, supported resolutions and durations, sample code, a short overview, and a side-by-side table of similar models, so picking the right model doesn't require testing each one in code.

## How do I get started?

1. Sign up for an API account, either as an individual or as a company.
2. Register a payment method and fund your balance.
3. Generate an API key in the console at open.higgsfield.ai. For security, the full key appears only once, so save it right away. Creating a key unlocks 20 concurrent requests.
4. Connect through the Python or TypeScript SDK, or call the REST API directly from any language with an HTTP client, sending requests to api.higgsfield.ai. Each model page carries sample code, and if you work through a coding agent, ready setup prompts for Claude Code, Cursor, and ChatGPT (Codex).

Full reference documentation, quickstart guides, and code examples are available at docs.higgsfield.ai.

## How is API usage billed?

Billing is pay-as-you-go from a US dollar balance, and the minimum top-up is $5. Video models are priced per second of output and image models per image; DoP is the exception, priced per generation. Each model has a fixed rate for every configuration: the rate depends on settings like resolution and audio, is listed publicly, and stays the same regardless of how much you top up. An estimate endpoint returns the cost of a request before you run it. Funds expire one year after they are added to the balance. The balance can't go below zero: once it's empty, new requests wait until you add funds, or you can turn on auto top-up so production traffic never stops.

You're only charged for generations that finish successfully. If a request fails, its cost returns to your balance automatically.

## How does generation work?

Generation is asynchronous. You submit a request and receive a request ID, then track progress by polling the status or by receiving a webhook when the result is ready. Once the generation completes, you download the output file.

...

## How is the API different from MCP and CLI?

MCP and CLI are agent connections: they attach Claude, Cursor, or another agent to your existing higgsfield.ai account, and everything they generate deducts your plan credits. The API doesn't touch your account or credits at all: it runs on its own key and dollar balance, and it's built for shipping generation inside your own product.

...

| --- | --- | --- |
| Account | Separate API account | Your higgsfield.ai account |
| Billing | US dollars per generation | Plan credits |
| API key | Yes | No |
| Best for | Building generation into your own product | Generating from an AI agent |

...

No. Open Higgsfield is the name of the API console at open.higgsfield.ai. The product, the catalog, and the billing are the same Higgsfield API.

Can I use the API without a Higgsfield plan?

Yes. The API works entirely on its own dollar balance. Having or not having a plan on higgsfield.ai changes nothing about API access or rates.

...

Can several people use one API account?

Yes. Every account starts as a personal organization, and you can create a team organization and invite people to it. To switch between workspaces, click your profile icon and open Organization. Usage across the account shows up in the Analytics and Billing sections.

mcp.title: What Is Higgsfield MCP and How It Differs
highlights:
Higgsfield MCP connects Higgsfield to AI agents. Connect once and generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Claude or any MCP-compatible agent, without leaving your agent. The main difference from generating on the web: MCP always uses credits. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on higgsfield.ai, so anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates.

## What is Higgsfield MCP?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open protocol that lets AI agents connect to external services and call their tools. Higgsfield MCP is a connector that lets you generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Higgsfield directly inside Claude or another MCP-compatible agent. It isn't the Higgsfield API: MCP connects to your existing account and uses your existing plan credits, with no API key required. For building generation into your own product with per-request billing, see What is the Higgsfield API, and how do I get started?

Because MCP connects programmatically, using Higgsfield through it falls under the Developer Terms in the Terms of Use. In short: keep your connection secure, and you're responsible for anything an agent generates through your account.

MCP connector URL: https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp

## How is MCP different from the web?

The most important difference is credit behavior: everything generated through MCP deducts credits, regardless of your plan.

How is MCP different from the web?

| Criteria | Web (higgsfield.ai) | MCP |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unlimited model access | Yes, where included in plan | No, always deducts credits |
| Free generations | Yes, where included in plan | No |
| Credit cost | Standard rates | Standard rates |
| Generations appear in Assets | Yes | Yes |
| Access to models | Yes | Yes |

## Do Unlimited models and free generations work through MCP?

No. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on higgsfield.ai: they're intended for manual use, not for automated or programmatic generation. Anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates. To generate on a model where your plan includes Unlimited access without spending credits, do it on the web at higgsfield.ai.

## What can I do through MCP?

- Image and video generation across the Higgsfield model lineup, with results saved to your Assets.
- Marketing Studio: paste a product link and get ready video ads built on a set of presets.
- Ad Multiplier: turn a reference ad and your product or character images into new versions of the same ad with a different product, location, hook, or CTA.
- Genjutsu: Motion Transfer, Object Swap, and Restyle for video.
- Upscale: raise the resolution and quality of your images and videos. How Upscale works on the website is covered in How do I use Upscale?
- Soul characters: train a character from photos and reuse it across generations.
- Higgsfield Audio and credit balance checks.
- Asset Library: browse your past generations and use them as references.

For the full list of operations and how to phrase requests to your agent, see How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent?

## Got any questions left?

Do I need a separate API key to use Higgsfield MCP?

No. MCP connects through OAuth authorization, no API key is needed. API keys belong to the Higgsfield API, a separate developer product. See What is the Higgsfield API, and how do I get started?

I have Unlimited access to a model, but MCP charged credits for it. Is that a bug?

No, that's expected. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on higgsfield.ai, so generating through MCP always uses credits at standard rates.

Does MCP work in other agents besides Claude?

Yes. Any MCP-compatible agent can connect using the same server URL: https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp. In ChatGPT, use the official Higgsfield Plugin instead: see How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent? Third-party agents are governed by their own terms, and you're responsible for how they use your Higgsfield account.

Where do my MCP generations appear?

In your Assets on higgsfield.ai, tagged with the MCP source. For details and troubleshooting, see How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent?

mcp.title: MCP, CLI & Plugins — Enterprise Help Center
highlights:
Generate from Claude, coding agents, Figma and Adobe apps with your workspace credits. No API key needed.

## Connect Higgsfield MCP

### Connect from Claude

1. In Claude (web or desktop), open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
2. Paste https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp and click Connect.
3. Sign in to Higgsfield in the window that opens.
4. Start a new chat and ask "What is my Higgsfield credit balance?" to confirm it works.

### Connect from ChatGPT

In ChatGPT, open Higgsfield’s connection page, choose Add Higgsfield in ChatGPT, and connect your Higgsfield account.

### What you can do through MCP

Generate images and video; upscale, remove backgrounds, expand; use Kling Motion Control, Soul characters and Elements; create voiceover, voice clones and dubbing; send outputs to folders; run Ad Multiplier. Outputs appear in Assets. Voice clones: 5 per workspace by default (ask your account manager for more).

For a reference file in Claude, ask Higgsfield to open its upload window, upload there, and wait for confirmation before generating. A file attached only to the Claude chat is not automatically passed to Higgsfield.

## What are the official Higgsfield platforms?

These are the core official Higgsfield surfaces:

- The Higgsfield website (higgsfield.ai). The only place to sign in, generate, manage your subscription, and pay.

...

mcp.title: MCP, CLI & Integrations - Higgsfield Help Center
highlights:
# MCP, CLI & Integrations

Generate from Claude, coding agents, Figma, Adobe apps and more - on your existing account and credits.

Beyond the web app, Higgsfield runs where your pipeline runs: an MCP server for chat agents, CLI + Skills for coding agents, and official plugins for design and video tools. None of them need an API key - they connect to your existing account and use your existing plan credits.

## Higgsfield MCP

MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI agents call Higgsfield directly. Connect once and generate images, videos, characters and audio from Claude or any MCP-compatible agent without opening the app. Server URL: https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp

Add the connector

In Claude (web or Desktop): Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp and click Connect.

Authorize

Sign in to your Higgsfield account in the authorization window - if you're already logged in on higgsfield.ai, this step is automatic.

Verify

Ask 'What is my Higgsfield credit balance?' in a new conversation - Claude should call the MCP tools and return your account data.

Through MCP you can run image and video generation on all models, upscaling, background removal, expand/reframe, Kling Motion Control, Soul characters and reference Elements, audio (voiceover, voice cloning, dubbing), and check the credit balance. All MCP generations land in your Assets on higgsfield.ai, tagged with the MCP source.

Tip

Claude has no native credit cap - if you want control, instruct it at the start of a session: 'Before generating anything, tell me the credit cost and wait for my confirmation.'

...

Credit behavior is the same everywhere: MCP, CLI and plugin generations use your plan balance at standard rates and appear in your Assets, exactly like generations made on the web.

Last updated July 24, 2026

highlights:
## What is Higgsfield MCP?

Higgsfield MCP connects Higgsfield's image, video, and audio models to the AI chat you already work in. MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets an AI agent call external tools. Once Higgsfield is connected, the agent can draft a script, pick a model, run the generation, and return a finished file, all inside one conversation. Higgsfield is an AI-native creative suite, and MCP is how it plugs into your AI workflow.

Claude (claude.ai and Claude Desktop), Cursor, and CLI-based agents such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes connect through the Higgsfield MCP server. ChatGPT connects through the official Higgsfield plugin from the Plugins Directory. Both routes use the same account and the same credits.

The model catalog covers 30+ options, including Seedance, Kling, and Soul. The agent selects a model that fits the task, or you can name one yourself in the prompt.

Setup takes a few minutes: in Claude, add a custom connector with the Higgsfield MCP server URL; in ChatGPT, add the Higgsfield plugin. An active subscription is required. Step-by-step instructions for every agent are in the help center guide: How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent?
